name: Does cabinet removal differ in older homes around the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: Does cabinet removal differ in older homes around the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In older homes across areas like Denver and Englewood, removing kitchen cabinets frequently reveals uneven studs, out-of-square corners, or older lath-and-plaster walls that require specialized attention. Unlike modern construction with standard drywall, plaster walls crack easily if fasteners are pried out forcefully. An experienced finish contractor will carefully back out fasteners, evaluate the framing behind the old soffits, and shim or re-drywall the area so your new cabinets will hang plumb and level against the historic framing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Older homes often feature plaster walls or uneven framing that require delicate fastener removal and wall leveling before new cabinets can hang plumb.
